lessons: Fiend Hunter, first-picked at p3p1, and Abbey Griffin, p3p7, were both stranded in a UG deck with only Moon Heron x2, Stitched Drake and Spectral Flight as fliers, so take on-colour fliers over off-colour removal.
Stitched Drake's 1UU ran on 7 Islands, breaking the guide's 8-source rule for double pips, and the UG went 2-6 in games, so count pips before the final build.
Tonight's games ran 12 to 24 turns, shorter than the guide's usual 18 to 29, so a UG built around Kindercatch, Grave Bramble and Festerhide Boar needed early pressure and evasion rather than fatties.
Prioritise removal over filler in pack 3: I left Urgent Exorcism and Inquisitor's Flail unplayed, then lost 0-2 to seat 6's Olivia Voldaren with only Rebuke and Sever the Bloodline as answers.
Black was my deepest colour: Bloodline Keeper, Reaper from the Abyss, Morkrut Banshee and Stromkirk Patrol anchored the deck that went 2-1, so commit to it early and pair it with white.
Hedge with a second-colour option: I cut red entirely, then lost 2-0 to seat 6's BR deck featuring Olivia Voldaren, Rage Thrower and Riot Devils.
The guide says fliers win, yet I sided Stitched Drake out for Dream Twist and Mulch against WB and lost game 2 in 24 turns; keep evasive threats in that matchup.
Smite the Monstrous can't hit Bloodline Keeper (power 3), so hold Rebuke or Claustrophobia for it and for Sever the Bloodline.
Blue-white fliers won rounds 1 and 3, so in pack 3 take cheap evasive threats over a second Doomed Traveler.
Don't spread early picks across three colours: I took Gallows Warden and Voiceless Spirit before settling blue, black then ended with only four playables, forcing a late UR pivot.
Count creatures before taking removal: my UR deck ran only 10 creatures and went 1-2, losing both matches to WU decks that answered my few threats.
Value evasive creatures like Moon Heron above Curse of the Bloody Tome, since the WU opponents I lost to used Claustrophobia and Feeling of Dread against my small board.
Victim of Night is BB, yet this BG ran two on 7 Swamps and 10 Forests, ignoring the guide's 8-source BB rule; go 9/8 or cut one.
The guide ranks BG best by matches, yet this BG went 1-2 and 3-5 in games, losing to WU's Chapel Geist, Invisible Stalker and Stitched Drake; take a third flier over Markov Patrician.
Markov Patrician was taken twice (p1p5, p3p7) and played, though the guide says to avoid top-end bloat; take a cheap two-drop or flier there instead.
Balefire Dragon was my pack 3 first pick, yet it never made my WU deck, so once you are two colours deep, take on-colour playables over off-colour bombs.
Seat 6's BR went 3-0 with Olivia Voldaren and Blazing Torch and beat my WU deck 2-1, so draft cheap removal like Sensory Deprivation and Claustrophobia earlier.
My 26-turn and 24-turn wins over BG show that long games reward evasive threats like Chapel Geist and Spectral Rider over vanilla bodies.
Red-black was open: Olivia Voldaren and Bloodgift Demon topped a 3-0 deck, with Devil's Play, Harvest Pyre and Blazing Torch answering blockers, so prioritise red removal to pair with black.
The guide says fliers win, yet round 2's WU deck, packing Claustrophobia, Fiend Hunter and Smite the Monstrous, took a game off me, so draft threats that survive removal.
Riot Devils and Tormented Pariah filled my curve, so take cheap bodies over Cobbled Wings, a guide-listed skip I took and never played.
Skip marginal late picks like Fortress Crab, Curse of Oblivion and Full Moon's Rise, which never made my deck; Desperate Ravings ended up as the 23rd card instead.
My two 1-2 losses went to grindy 17 to 23-turn games, so take evasive or card-advantage threats like Falkenrath Noble before a third Night Terrors or Brain Weevil.
Don't take a second situational Ghoulcaller's Chant (pick 9, pack 3) over a playable creature; that copy never made my deck.
